steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Record. Each measured time is written to the test record against its target.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 test has no measured restore time

findings.title: Restore time not measured
findings.fix: Measure the restore and record the time

findings.title: Result does not match the measured time
Gap with no action
findings.fix: Name the action and its owner

outcome.notChecked: Recovery of real data at scale.

pros: Flags a test with no measured time, a result that does not match the measured time, and a gap with no action.
cons: Not checked: Recovery of real data at scale.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-techops-dr-test skill on the records for this review.
